title: Checkout my idle game made mainly with Codex for a month
author: esgange
selftext:
Game is called Lootforged, were main progression is mainly you just progress from loots on an idle loop. Meant to be played on a vacant tab, or just run on ur pc overnight. xD

I know I have a very bad graphics as I try to make my own back end 2d rig and 2nd animation, each animation only have max 8 frames. I try to make it my own so it can be unique/non generic even tho its not as good. 

I eventually plan every art and game data be hosted on dex, so art size is very limited \~10-20kb. Main game loop is complete, but on art i don't know how to proceed, rig of pets and icon art is there but  generating all body images for all pets parts on rig is a loong process, as well as all armors for players/human enemies.

Anyway, please try it here: [`https://lootforged.online/`](https://lootforged.online/) `acess code: lootlootloot`

`This is my first ever public post about this game and only here I shared acess code.`
